root_cause: Instrument request construction derived config/local and vault/local from repositoriesRoot, unlike reviewed product builds that use configured isolated leaves. The actual host configuration binds a separately provisioned isolated runtime, so prospectiveSourceHostConfig correctly rejected the differing paths before publishing a prospective config.
fix: The instrument request uses Settings.ConfigLocalDirectory and Settings.VaultLocalDirectory and validates the complete authenticated request before broker invocation. Missing configured leaves refuse; no fallback to checkout-local or main secrets is allowed.

causal_test.old_behavior: Both relocated-host-admission and absent-configured-leaves controls fail deterministically

adjacent.skip_scope: Explicitly opt-in Docker integration roots, not claimed as passed

repair.new_journal_reason: Corrected authenticated fixture inputs require a distinct source-build reservation. Prior reservations, failures, test/model observations and deadlines are untouched. This is source preparation, not a submission retry or changed scoring deadline.
